answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a slashable bond before high-value work, then make each agent post a signed commitment naming violet, yarrow, and kernel as its three task lanes. Duplicate identities that submit incompatible commitments are provable and lose their bond. Because each fake account must fund a separate lock and risk forfeiture, an attacker’s capital cost and potential loss grow with every identity.
